scenario: A senior admin reviews a staged category edit and determines it should not be applied; the system needs a documented outcome for rejection.
draft_obligation: The approval operation must define both approval and rejection outcomes before any category update is applied.
preliminary_reason: FRBLOCK-027 establishes senior-admin approval for staged category changes and applies the update upon approval, but it does not document a rejection/return outcome or explicitly prevent the category update when approval is denied. This is an in-scope missing approval-workflow obligation rather than an already covered requirement.
supplement: The system shall provide both approval and rejection outcomes for senior-admin review of staged category changes, and shall not apply the category update when the senior admin rejects it.
